cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('src/md4c.c').read_text()
s=s.replace('static int\nmd_start_new_block(MD_CTX* ctx, const MD_LINE_ANALYSIS* line)\n{\n    MD_BLOCK* block;', 'static int\nmd_start_new_block(MD_CTX* ctx, const MD_LINE_ANALYSIS* line)\n{\n    if(line->type==0 || line->type==4 || line->type==9 || line->type==10 || line->type>10) fprintf(stderr,"BADSTART type=%d beg=%u end=%u ncont=%d nbytes=%d current=%p\\n", line->type, line->beg, line->end, ctx->n_containers, ctx->n_block_bytes, (void*)ctx->current_block);\n    MD_BLOCK* block;')
Path('/tmp/md4c_bad.c').write_text(s)
PY



cc -O0 -I src /tmp/repro.c /tmp/md4c_bad.c src/md4c-html.c src/entity.c -o /tmp/repro_bad
